# CREDO Analyzer

CREDO Analyzer is a local web dashboard and research workspace for
detection data associated with the CREDO ecosystem.

## Primary application files

app/server.py
Main HTTP backend and API.

app/index.html
Main browser interface.

app/app.js
Main frontend runtime and shared polling.

app/features.js
Extended analysis and research interface.

app/timelapse.js
Detection timelapse functionality.

app/style.css
Main stylesheet.

app/network_import.py
Data/network import support.

app/legacy.py
Legacy/support dashboard functionality.

## Third-party upstream source

app/credo-data-exporter_universal.py

This file is a byte-identical upstream file from:

credo-science/credo-api-tools

Read CODE_PROVENANCE.yaml before modifying it.

## Documentation and policy

README.md
Human-facing installation and usage documentation.

AGENTS.md
Editing and provenance rules for AI coding agents.

CODE_PROVENANCE.yaml

THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
Third-party notices.

CITATION.cff
Citation metadata.

LICENSE
MIT license for project-local code.

## Installation and validation

.env.example
Safe public configuration template.

install.sh --check
Read-only installation/readiness check.

install.sh
Prepares a local installation.

tools/verify-provenance.sh
Checks the exact upstream CREDO exporter.

tools/public-preflight.sh
Checks the public repository candidate tree.

## Important rules

Do not commit runtime data, databases, detection images, logs,
credentials, .env files, caches, backups or virtual environments.

Do not silently rewrite the upstream CREDO exporter.

Distinguish external APIs and scientific datasets from copied source
code.

Keep 127.0.0.1 as the default bind address.

Prefer small behaviour-preserving changes.

Before committing run:

    ./install.sh --check
    ./tools/public-preflight.sh
    git diff --check

Known audited production environment:

macOS 12.7.6
Intel x86_64
Python 3.14

GitHub CI profile:

Python 3.12
Node.js 22
